title: A cubic with negative leading coefficient
caption: With leading term −2x³ the graph rises on the left and falls on the right; it crosses the y-axis at (0, 4), and a cubic can turn at most twice.
alt: The graph of y = −2x cubed plus 5x squared minus x plus 4, rising on the left and falling on the right, crossing the y-axis at (0, 4).
description: The leading term −2x³ dominates for large |x|: the graph is up on the left and down on the right.
A cubic has at most 2 turning points; this one has a minimum then a maximum.
